phase: frozen synthetic repeated-calibration and row-imbalance extension
sampling: Counts fixed before sampling; same active-row total budget across regimes; terminal rows unobserved. Imbalanced allocation uses generating-world expected active visits, with bottom quarter unsupported. Not adaptive stopping or a human guarantee.
interpretation: Known terminal labels are extra environment specification, not inferred from observed zero counts. Methods/support controls share counts and are not independent datasets. This extension does not replace the complete earlier 200-world uncertainty campaign.
monte_carlo: Report fixed-world repeated coverage with the calibration dataset as unit; simultaneous Monte Carlo intervals and width summaries require a separate audited aggregation.
